actions.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so that telnet to 127.0.0.1:6665 reaches the guest login prompt, and leave it running until ready.
required_artifacts: A host TCP listener on 127.0.0.1:6665 connected to the guest console/serial
required_behaviors: QEMU must be launched in the background
The service must be reachable via telnet on 127.0.0.1:6665
Readiness is only satisfied when the login prompt is observable
known_invalid_patterns: Treating file existence or command success as sufficient
Treating a non-listening port as ready
Stopping QEMU after launch instead of leaving it running
verification_plan: Locate the ISO and determine a QEMU invocation that maps the guest console to telnet on 127.0.0.1:6665
Probe 127.0.0.1:6665 until the login prompt is confirmed
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the QEMU launch command and background process
Receipt-backed evidence that 127.0.0.1:6665 is accepting telnet connections and shows the login prompt
